{{Quote|The Sith then asks, ''"How would you like to command all the clans? The Empire wishes to build a base here to command this sector of the Outer Rim."''<nowiki></nowiki>|[[Rikkar-Du]], addressing the [[Codru-Ji]] of [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]]|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 13">[[Legacy (2006) 13|''Legacy'' (2006) 13]]</ref>}}
The '''Pakuuni sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
[[File:Pakuuni_sector.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Pakuuni sector and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
The Pakuuni sector saw many important actions during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and was often policed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in their efforts to suppress the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a large Imperial task force [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|engaged]] a Rebel fleet above the planet [[Turkana/Legends|Turkana]] in the [[Turkana system/Legends|Turkana system]], during which the Rebels first deployed the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] against Imperial forces. Rebel losses were heavy, but the success of the X-wing in routing the Imperials during this engagement prompted the Alliance to mass produce the X-wing as the mainstay all purpose starfighter within their fleet.

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Imperial forces screened all civilian traffic passing through the sector in an effort to track down Rebel survivors fleeing the aftermath of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. During this effort, the Alliance and their allies, the [[Pakuuni Pirates]] attempted to remove the Imperial presence by incapacitating their main base operations. This effort failed and the Empire reasserted its control over the contested sector.
